The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Prime Meat Curries can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Prime Meat]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Goron Spice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. [[Link]] can eat these curries to have some of his [[Heart]]s restored. Since high-quality [[Meat]] is used when making these [[Meal]]s, they have a deeper taste than other curries. Link can add additional [[Ingredient]]s when making Prime Meat Curry, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Meat Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Consuming these will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Meat Curry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. These curries will refill part of Link's Stamina Wheel if eaten. * '''Hasty Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Link will receive a boost to his movement speed by eating these. * '''Hearty Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Meat Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. These curries will increase Link's attack power when they're consumed. * '''Sneaky Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. If these curries are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Prime Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The high-quality meat in this curry has given it a deeper taste than most other curries.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Link's [[Defense]] will be boosted if he eats these. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Meat Curry * Meal * Meat Curry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
